issue_context.title: Can not reenable ui event filters
issue_context.body:
### Description of the problem / feature request:

Running this works as expected:
```
$ bazel test //main-street/... --ui_event_filters=-DEBUG,-INFO
INFO: Build completed successfully, 1 total action
Test cases: finished with 4280 passing and 0 failing out of 4280 test cases

INFO: Build completed successfully, 1 total action
```

But if you try to put them back, it doesn't do anything:
```
$ bazel test //main-street/... --ui_event_filters=-DEBUG,-INFO --ui_event_filters=+DEBUG,+INFO
INFO: Build completed successfully, 1 total action
Test cases: finished with 4280 passing and 0 failing out of 4280 test cases

INFO: Build completed successfully, 1 total action
```

I expect the second command to output the same thing as if I just did:
```
$ bazel test //main-street/... --ui_event_filters=+DEBUG,+INFO
INFO: Invocation ID: 1dd3145a-0ce8-424c-aae2-7a3622bef944
DEBUG: /private/var/tmp/_bazel_paul.tarjan/16b823dd05de063e5dc3f5967533d5ec/external/bazel_gazelle/internal/go_repository.bzl:189:18: com_github_confluentinc_confluent_kafka_go: gazelle: /private/var/tmp/_bazel_paul.tarjan/16b823dd05de063e5dc3f5967533d5ec/external/com_github_confluentinc_confluent_kafka_go/kafka/go_rdkafka_generr/go_rdkafka_generr.go: error reading go file: /private/var/tmp/_bazel_paul.tarjan/16b823dd05de063e5dc3f5967533d5ec/external/com_github_confluentinc_confluent_kafka_go/kafka/go_rdkafka_generr/go_rdkafka_generr.go: pkg-config not supported: #cgo pkg-config: --static rdkafka
gazelle: /private/var/tmp/_bazel_paul.tarjan/16b823dd05de063e5dc3f5967533d5ec/external/com_github_confluentinc_confluent_kafka_go/kafka/build_dynamic.go: error reading go file: /private/var/tmp/_bazel_paul.tarjan/16b823dd05de063e5dc3f5967533d5ec/external/com_github_confluentinc_confluent_kafka_go/kafka/build_dynamic.go: pkg-config not supported: #cgo pkg-config: rdkafka
gazelle: /private/var/tmp/_bazel_paul.tarjan/16b823dd05de063e5dc3f5967533d5ec/external/com_github_confluentinc_confluent_kafka_go/kafka/build_static.go: error reading go file: /private/var/tmp/_bazel_paul.tarjan/16b823dd05de063e5dc3f5967533d5ec/external/com_github_confluentinc_confluent_kafka_go/kafka/build_static.go: pkg-config not supported: #cgo pkg-config: rdkafka-static
gazelle: /private/var/tmp/_bazel_paul.tarjan/16b823dd05de063e5dc3f5967533d5ec/external/com_github_confluentinc_confluent_kafka_go/kafka/build_static_all.go: error reading go file: /private/var/tmp/_bazel_paul.tarjan/16b823dd05de063e5dc3f5967533d5ec/external/com_github_confluentinc_confluent_kafka_go/kafka/build_static_all.go: pkg-config not supported: #cgo pkg-config: rdkafka-static
INFO: Analyzed 385 targets (0 packages loaded, 0 targets configured).
INFO: Found 274 targets and 111 test targets...
INFO: Elapsed time: 0.428s, Critical Path: 0.00s
INFO: 1 process: 1 internal.
INFO: Build completed successfully, 1 total action
Test cases: finished with 4280 passing and 0 failing out of 4280 test cases

INFO: Build completed successfully, 1 total action
```
I expected the algorithm would be to have to a bit for each type of error and as your parse the arguments you turn the bit on if you see a `+foo` or `foo` and turn it off if you see a `-foo`. I don't understand what "or override the default set completely with direct assignment" in the docs means.

### Feature requests: what underlying problem are you trying to solve with this feature?

I want to be able to make a `--config=verbose` mode that turns these back on for people but make the default one turn them off.

### What operating system are you running Bazel on?

OSX

### What's the output of `bazel info release`?

```
$ bazel info release
INFO: Invocation ID: 736bf2b4-a1d6-4642-b7ed-05dec1280d2d
release 4.0.0
```
